work.lede: None of these projects is a real client: they are three interfaces built end to end to show, concretely, what careful code changes. Drag the handle to compare.

projects.name: Clairière
projects.challenge: A dense back office, accumulated over the years, where every piece of information took seven clicks and two memories.
projects.result: Rebuilt screen by screen: fewer columns, more decisions. HR teams now find what matters in two clicks.

projects.name: Comptoir
projects.challenge: A carefully curated catalogue, but a checkout that multiplied steps — and abandoned carts.
projects.result: A shorter, reassuring journey from product to payment. The cart stops being an exit door.

projects.name: Pulso
projects.challenge: A stressful first patient journey, designed for the IT department rather than the waiting room.
projects.result: Short steps, large type, human language. An app you can use even on a bad day.

about.title: A developer, not an agency
about.lede: R-X is an independent web developer: the person who listens to your needs is the one who writes the code. No middle layer, no signal loss.
about.story1: I handle the whole cycle: understanding the need, choosing the tech, building, testing, launching, maintaining. You only explain your project once — decisions come faster, answers come straighter.
about.story2: I believe in restrained code. Few dependencies, justified technical choices, pages that load fast: every line earns its place by serving the project, or it goes. Demanding to write, restful to use — and far simpler to maintain.

values.title: Restraint
values.text: Every added dependency is a debt. I code what serves, and remove what weighs things down.

values.title: Rigour
values.text: Versioned code, automated tests, backups: nothing goes live without being checked.

values.title: Transparency
values.text: Clear quotes, deadlines kept — and the truth when something gets stuck.

cta.title: Want a technical look at your site?
